subject: Mutual action plan: onboarding timeline, canary window and training cadence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@railwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: onboarding timeline, canary window and training cadence

Ben — attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout windows, canary, migration cutover, and training schedule. Key asks in this note: please confirm the preferred canary week, which production slice you want in Wave 1, and a single point of contact for ops during the migration (we'll need an OOO/backfill contact if anyone is out).

High-level:
- Week 0 (prep): account provisioning, API keys, test dataset ingestion.
- Week 1 (canary): 1% traffic + shadow for 10% traffic; scheduled weekday 9–5 PST.
- Week 2 (staged ramp): 10% -> 50% with rollback gates.
- Week 3 (full migration): cutover and training for superusers.

Attachments: RailwayHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains milestone-level owners and acceptance criteria. Also included: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (summary checklist).

Proposed canary windows we can support: May 11–15, May 18–22, or May 25–29. If you prefer an evening/weekend window, call that out and we'll surface ops staffing.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Reply with preferred canary week and Wave 1 traffic slice.
2) Ops contact and test dataset ETA.
3) Book a 30-min alignment call (I can carve calendar slots Wed/Thu).

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@railwayhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@railwayhealth.com>, Gina Park <gina.park@railwayhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: onboarding timeline, canary window and training cadence

Vanessa — thanks for sending this over and for the clear breakdown. Quick responses inline: 

- Preferred canary week: May 18–22 (we have a support window that week and prefer to avoid the holiday weekend).
- Wave 1 traffic slice: start at 5% for the first 48 hours then shadow at ~20% for two business days before ramping.
- Ops contact: Gina Park (gina.park@railwayhealth.com) — she'll be the primary on-call during the canary; copy ops@railwayhealth.com for escalation.

A couple of open items from our side:
1) Test data: we can deliver a sanitized snapshot by May 12; final full dataset won't be available until May 29. Will the canary proceed with the sanitized snapshot?
2) SSO / SAML integration: security wants the SAML metadata exchanged before the canary. Can you confirm the earliest we can do that?

If those two items are blockers we'll need to slide the canary to May 25–29. Otherwise, May 18–22 works. Happy to jump on a call Wednesday at 11:00 if that helps.

— Ben
Ben Thomas
Head of Platform Ops, Railway Health
ben.thomas@railwayhealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Thomas <ben.thomas@railwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: onboarding timeline, canary window and training cadence

Ben — great, thanks for the quick answers. Couple of clarifications and commitments from our side: 

- Canary approach: we can do the 5% for 48 hours + 20% shadow for two days as you described. Acceptance gates in the MAP will be: 99th percentile latency under 450ms, error rate <0.5%, and no data-loss incidents during the shadow period.
- Test data: sanitized snapshot by May 12 is fine — we'll run canary against that. Note: full-data acceptance tests will be re-run post-cutover (Week 3) when you provide the final dataset.
- SAML/Security: Karthik will own the SAML metadata exchange. Karthik, can you confirm we can complete SAML setup by May 14? If not, we should shift.

I've updated the MAP to mark Gina as the ops SOP contact and added the acceptance gates. I've also added a short training plan: two 60-minute live sessions for superusers (Day 2 of the staged ramp) plus a recorded walkthrough. See attached MAP v1.1 (spreadsheet note).

I'll book a 30-min alignment call for Wed 11:00 PT — sending an invite now. If that slot doesn't work reply with alternatives.

Thanks — Vanessa

Looping in a commercial note — thanks for drafting the MAP. Two items from Revenue Ops: 

1) Discount/credit: Per the deal terms we can honor the onboarding credit tied to a May canary but need the signed addendum returned before the canary start. I'll send a DocuSign link in a separate email (no later than EOD).
2) SLA exception: the customer requested a 99.9% target for the first 30 days; legal has approved a playbook but requires the acceptance gates to be explicitly enumerated in the MAP (we already have latency/error gates — I'll add a line item for uptime measurement and reporting cadence).

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
